dataset: SPIE-AAPM Lung CT Challenge Calibration Cohort (10 scans)

matching_rule_distinction.official_luna16_rule: Euclidean distance d < max(diameter_mm / 2.0, 5.0 mm), where diameter_mm is annotated in ground truth
matching_rule_distinction.pilot_spie_aapm_rule: Euclidean distance d < 5.0 mm fixed Cartesian distance threshold
matching_rule_distinction.reason_for_difference: LUNGx/SPIE-AAPM calibration ground-truth provides only (x, y, slice) center points without nodule diameter or contour annotations

annotation_completeness_and_false_positi.lungx_challenge_scope: Classification (benign vs malignant) of a single primary biopsy-proven nodule per patient
annotation_completeness_and_false_positi.unannotated_pulmonary_structures: LUNGx reference explicitly does NOT exhaustively annotate secondary benign nodules, granulomas, scars, lymph nodes, or vascular bifurcations
annotation_completeness_and_false_positi.consequence_for_cad_fp_evaluation: Candidate proposals categorized as false positives are non-matches to the single biopsy target, but may represent true physiological nodules or granulomas unannotated in the challenge protocol

bootstrap_cluster_properties.resampling: 10 patients drawn with replacement; when patient P is drawn k times, its target nodule and all 400 candidate rows are replicated k times
bootstrap_cluster_properties.denominator_consistency: Scan count denominator and nodule target denominator both equal 10 in every bootstrap sample
bootstrap_cluster_properties.interpolation_robustness: Linear vs step-wise interpolation yields identical CPM because true nodule probabilities are separated at Rank 1 (0 FPs at threshold)
